thread:
Sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands security segment. Several folks asked for concrete owners and dates for SOC2/ISO evidence, BYO KMS, VPC/private connectivity, and audit-log retention. Can we capture actions here so sales and support have a single source?

Isha: Yes — happy to own coordination. High-level: draft SOC2 evidence package by end of next quarter; BYO KMS (customer-managed keys) in engineering review now, aiming for a beta in ~8 weeks; audit-log retention configurable up to 365 days behind a feature flag.

Jordan: Tech note on Private deployments: we recommend AWS PrivateLink + VPC endpoints for zero Internet egress. We still support VPC peering for legacy integrators but it needs extra routing and NAT configs.

Maggie: For ISO we need more artifacts than SOC2 initial pack — access review exports, KMS key policy snapshots, rotation docs. Security will need infra to export examples so we can template evidence.

Sam: Can we list DRIs and short deadlines? Folks want one place to check progress.

Isha: DRIs and timeline proposal: SOC2 evidence (initial) -> Isha (security) + Kira (compliance) — due 2026-06-15. BYO KMS beta -> Jordan (infra) + Sam (product) — due 2026-05-20. PrivateLink / VPC checklist -> Jordan -> due 2026-05-01. Audit-log retention flag & tenant setting -> Kira + Jordan -> due 2026-05-10.

Jordan: Technical checklist: PrivateLink requires publishing a service name per region, updating our terraform modules, and providing an example endpoint policy. Will include this snippet in the doc:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect": "Allow","Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodPrivateAccess"},"Action": "execute-api:Invoke","Resource": "*"}]
}```

Kira: Audit logs: default retention stays 90 days, we'll expose a tenant-level control to extend up to 365 days and provide export endpoints. Product needs to design the UX (retention slider + export button).

Maggie: Compliance nuance: SOC2 needs documented key rotation policy and HSM usage where applicable. For BYO KMS with external HSMs, we need an attestation template. Isha, can security prepare a customer-facing checklist and attestation template?

Isha: Yes, will produce checklist covering key policy review, rotation cadence, KMS grants, and HSM attestation. Draft by 2026-04-28.

Sam: Also propose weekly 30m office hours for compliance questions until SOC2 milestone — Tuesdays 9am PT.

Jordan: Infra OK with that slot. I'll schedule recurring and invite security/legal.

Security-Bot: Automated scan: 3 infra accounts missing explicit KMS key policy statements in last 24h. Created ticket INFRA-4823.

Kira: I'll triage INFRA-4823 with Jordan tomorrow morning.

Sam: Recap of action items:
- SOC2 evidence package -> Isha + Kira -> due 2026-06-15
- BYO KMS beta -> Jordan + Sam -> due 2026-05-20
- PrivateLink + VPC checklist -> Jordan -> due 2026-05-01
- Audit-log retention flag -> Kira + Jordan -> due 2026-05-10
- Customer KMS/HSM checklist -> Isha -> draft 2026-04-28
- Weekly office hours (Tues 9am PT) -> Jordan to schedule

Sam: If anyone needs to swap ownership or adjust dates, reply here. I'll compile into Confluence and ping when the page is live. :thumbsup:

Maggie: I'll attach sample artifacts and an ISO evidence mapping folder to the Confluence page once it's created.

Jordan: I'll post the terraform PR for module changes later today and link it here.

Sam: Thanks everyone — this clarity will help pre-sales and customers.

Kira: :+1: I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a legal/compliance walkthrough and share the evidence checklist draft when ready.
